name: pickup_respawn_queue_update
description: PickupRespawnQueue::Update respawns expired pickup entries, unlinks and deletes them, and leaves future entries queued.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Pickup runtime source-cluster pass. BN currently renders the x87 status-word timer comparison and predecessor search awkwardly, but assembly and MLIL agree on the source behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41e5d0 verifies the global queue count/head/tail accesses, the x87 timer check for entry->when < g_Time_UnscaledAccumulatedTimeSec, Pickup::RespawnSpawnDef call, next-entry preservation before unlink, head and interior removal paths, tail repair, empty-list unused/tail clearing, and operator delete on removed entries. The native smoke covers expired head and tail removal while preserving a future middle entry.
